note: in-memory mutations of the golden pockets; the batch comparison must report a mismatch for exactly the named id and none for the others. The ids are loaded golden ids of the same pocket shapes: the 7-MODS-X ids are mod items and the unit-test world (core+test_data) does not load the mods, so B5 (which compares a loaded item) cannot name them. Each mutation kind is the one the packet rows use: MAGAZINE ammo cap (glockmag, glockbigmag), MAGAZINE_WELL item_restriction/default/volume (m1911, skorpion_61), allowed_speedloaders (m1903).
